firstStepsSheetIntro: None of these are required — the logger and your weekly plan work without any of them. They are the parts of the app most people never find.
firstStepWorkoutWhy: One logged set is all Mission Coach needs to start building your week.
firstStepSession2Why: Two sessions in week one locks the habit. Coach builds from the logs — not every pillar at once.
week1SecondSessionReason: One session logged. A second this week locks the loop — Coach builds from the logs, not another pillar.
week1SecondSessionCoachDesc: Session two of week one — from the plan that already saw your first log.
firstStepFuelWhy: Protein is the one number worth watching early. Nothing else is required.
firstStepMindWhy: How rested you feel changes what the coach asks of you tomorrow.
firstStepMoveWhy: Five minutes on the days you do not train is what keeps the streak reachable.
firstStepLearnWhy: Knowing why a session is built the way it is makes it easier to keep going.
firstStepParqWhy: A short safety questionnaire before Mission Coach generates a week. Log set never waits on it.
publicStatusOpenBeta: {{productVersion}} — open alpha. Offline logging plus Mission Coach from your logs.
